{{Quote|This is where the ''Lady Luck'' is berthed. It's just south of the Windward docks. Know where that is?''"<br />"''Of course. I've flown in and out of Coruscant enough times.|Lando Calrissian and Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />}}
The '''Windward docks''' were a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" /> In [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] berthed [[Gender/Legends|his]]<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" /> [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub]] [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]]<ref name="TNEGtVaV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref> [[Lady Luck/Legends|''Lady Luck'']] at a place just south of the Windward docks. When Calrissian recruited his friend, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to join him on his search to find a a suitable [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], he instructed Skywalker to meet him where the ''Lady Luck'' was berthed. He provided Skywalker with a piece of [[Paper/Legends|paper]] detailing to spot just south of the Windward docks. Skywalker was already familiar with the docks, having flown in and out of Coruscant many times. Calrissian and Skywalker planned to meet there after breakfast the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Windward docks were first mentioned in the [[1995]] novel ''[[Ambush at Corellia]]'', written by [[Roger MacBride Allen]].<ref name="Ambush at Corellia" />
